single.rationale: Ingersoll Rand shows solid fundamentals with strong FCF generation (15.9% margin) and recurring aftermarket revenue (36.5% of total), but concerning deceleration in profitability is evident: operating income declined from $1.3B to $1.1B in FY2025 despite revenue growth, and net income fell sharply from $839M to $581M. The valuation appears stretched at 58x P/E and 28x P/FCF for mid-single-digit revenue growth, suggesting limited upside without material operational improvement.
